method: Reference sets were authored first, from the transcripts, before any digest existed. Extractor recall and spuriousness were then adjudicated against those reference sets. Coverage verdicts were assigned by reading each t250 digest against each extractor conclusion. The rule applied throughout: an item counts as recovered or covered when a reader could draw the conclusion from what is there — meaning survives, phrasing need not.
